name: Washington
sources: Washington capital gains excise tax (RCW 82.87): 7% on long-term gains above the standard deduction ($278,000 for 2025, indexed), plus an additional 2.9% on gains above $1,000,000 (SB 5813, 2025). Retirement accounts and real estate are exempt; dividends and interest are not taxed
update_instructions: Update the standard deduction (indexed annually by WA DOR) and verify the rate tiers.
